analysis_type: Error and Disagreement Analysis (Simulated Stakeholder Validation)
methodology_statement: This analysis evaluates discrepancies between automated evidence-based recommendations and simulated reviewer decisions. The validation is explicitly simulated and does not claim real hospital stakeholder feedback.

disagreement_cases.reviewer_reason: Department Head clinician with administrative and teaching responsibilities; lower patient entry count than peers is expected.
disagreement_cases.possible_rule_issue: System baseline computes peer averages across all clinicians without title distinction.
disagreement_cases.suggested_improvement: Introduce sub-role or administrative title segmentation within peer comparison groups.

disagreement_cases.reviewer_reason: Staff member transferred from Emergency to Outpatient last week; legacy acute care permissions must be revoked.
disagreement_cases.possible_rule_issue: System depends on periodic HR batch synchronization which lags recent ward reassignments.
disagreement_cases.suggested_improvement: Integrate real-time HR event webhooks for immediate ward reassignment and leave tracking.

disagreement_cases.reviewer_reason: Specialist consultant on bi-monthly on-call duty; sparse log frequency is standard for this contract.
disagreement_cases.possible_rule_issue: System evaluated access within a rigid 30-day window without considering bi-monthly specialty shifts.
disagreement_cases.suggested_improvement: Add role-specific activity windows (e.g., 90-day evaluation for Visiting Consultants).

disagreement_cases.reviewer_reason: Intern on approved two-week academic rotation leave returning next Monday; access should not be suspended.
disagreement_cases.possible_rule_issue: System depends on periodic HR batch synchronization which lags recent ward reassignments.
disagreement_cases.suggested_improvement: Integrate real-time HR event webhooks for immediate ward reassignment and leave tracking.

disagreement_cases.reviewer_reason: Vendor SLA contract was renegotiated to read-only diagnostics; WRITE permission should be downgraded.
disagreement_cases.possible_rule_issue: Access logs showed valid technical usage, but contract scope was narrowed in procurement records.
disagreement_cases.suggested_improvement: Incorporate Vendor Management System (VMS) contract metadata into entitlement risk scoring.

disagreement_cases.reviewer_reason: Technician ran automated end-of-month calibration batch scripts, causing usage deviation; verified as legitimate.
disagreement_cases.possible_rule_issue: System flagged high peer deviation caused by scheduled automated calibration batches.
disagreement_cases.suggested_improvement: Exclude service-account and automated calibration batch runs from human user peer baselines.

rule_improvement_recommendations.observation: Department Head clinicians were flagged for low usage because clinical peer groups grouped administrative leaders with full-time floor doctors.
rule_improvement_recommendations.recommendation: Segment peer comparison baselines by administrative role flags (e.g., Department Head, Teaching Faculty vs Staff Clinician).

rule_improvement_recommendations.observation: Staff transferred to new departments retained old acute permissions that the system approved due to legacy usage in past 30 days.
rule_improvement_recommendations.recommendation: Integrate real-time HR transfer webhooks to trigger immediate automated deprovisioning of departed ward entitlements.

rule_improvement_recommendations.observation: Visiting Consultants and on-call surgeons operate on bi-monthly schedules, causing false-positive dormancy flags under 30-day lookback.
rule_improvement_recommendations.recommendation: Implement configurable evaluation lookback windows (e.g., 90-day evaluation for Visiting Consultants vs 30 days for permanent staff).

rule_improvement_recommendations.observation: Interns on mandatory academic examination leave were flagged for inactivity despite scheduled return.
rule_improvement_recommendations.recommendation: Ingest hospital residency rotation schedules and approved academic leave data into the evidence engine.

rule_improvement_recommendations.observation: Contractor permissions were approved by system based on access history, despite procurement contract narrowing.
rule_improvement_recommendations.recommendation: Connect Vendor Management System (VMS) contract scope flags to automatically downgrade third-party entitlements upon SLA change.

rule_improvement_recommendations.observation: Technicians executing scheduled end-of-month batch calibration runs had inflated usage flags.
rule_improvement_recommendations.recommendation: Distinguish between automated batch script executions and interactive user sessions when computing peer usage distributions.
